citation.authors: Buchanan BK, Siebert DM, Zigman Suchsland ML, Drezner JA et al

cited_by.title: Sickle cell trait and hard exercise

record.design: Observational comparison of sudden death associated with sickle cell trait before and after mandatory NCAA screening and education in 2010
record.finding: In Division I football the incidence of death associated with the trait fell from 1 in 28,145 athlete-years before legislation (9 deaths) to 1 in 250,468 after (1 death), a relative risk of 0.112 (95% CI 0.003-0.811). Cases outside football were rare. The authors' stated hypothesis was that legislation would reduce incidence.
record.note: Before-and-after, not randomised; the policy bundled screening and education, so it cannot separate them.
